name: decompile_all
description: Write provider pseudocode for every analyzed function, or a filtered subset, into a caller-selected directory and return only a manifest. Each file records the provider function name, canonical address, inclusive body ranges when procedure_info supplies them, and that function's procedure_info and pseudocode limitations. Each function's index record keeps its latest attempt and its complete limitations; the journal keeps earlier attempts and their limitations. Evidence keeps at most eight first-observed distinct per-function limitations within an encoded-text budget; the omitted count measures observations, not distinct warnings. The manifest reports counts, the output directory, the index path, at most 32 failure details within 2,048 JSON-encoded UTF-8 bytes (names can be omitted; full names remain in the index), provider identity, and the analysis-profile digest. Pseudocode stays in the files. An existing directory is refused unless resume is set and the journal matches the target SHA-256, provider, and analysis profile; verified files are skipped and conflicting files are left unchanged. layout dwarf reports that compilation-unit paths are unavailable and names files by address. Set retry_failed: independent_fresh to retry a null result explicitly reported as a function failure when supported; the failed attempt stays in the journal and the new attempt may use different analysis context. Errors and omissions without that typed fact are not retried. A failure of one function does not stop the others. Functions procedure_info classifies as external are counted as external, get no file, and are not decompiled; a resume skips them. Cancellation leaves files already written. Per-function limits do not bound the whole call; use limit and resume to select work that fits the client deadline, including import, listing and file work.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

address_end.description: Inclusive upper bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_start.

address_start.description: Inclusive lower bound as 0xoffset or space:0xoffset. Must use the same address space as address_end.

layout.description: address names files by canonical address. dwarf asks for compilation-unit paths and is reported unavailable when the provider has no such fact.

limit.description: Maximum functions to attempt on this call after skipping verified files and functions recorded as external. Further matches remain for a later resume.

name.description: Case-sensitive literal substring of the provider function name.

namespace.description: Case-sensitive prefix of the provider function name, including any separator such as Foo:: or Class.

output_directory.description: Absolute output directory. The parent must exist. The directory itself must be absent unless resume is true. One run at a time may use a directory; a second run is refused while the first holds it.

resume.description: Continue a journal for the same target SHA-256, provider, analysis profile, and layout. Both digests must be known. Verified files and functions recorded as external are skipped, conflicting files are left unchanged, and functions not yet tried run before retries of recorded failures.

retry_failed.description: For a null result explicitly reported as a function failure, retain the failure and try an independent decompile when supported. It can use different analysis context; errors and omissions without that typed fact are not retried.
